messages:
maria: On the rollout details page — can we add a lightweight 'export change proof' button that bundles actor + diff + canary snapshot? Need this for compliance teams to download evidence quickly.

sam: yeah, but we have quota + presigned-link concerns. If many teams click export we could spike egress. maybe require a preflight check to show cost/size estimate.

kevin: +1 for preflight. Also need to decide NDJSON small vs full envelope. Proposal: default to compact NDJSON with actor_id, action, timestamp, diff_base64. Full bundle (signed, attachments) on demand.

jen: question — where do we show who viewed/downloaded exports? console audit should log 'export.requested' + 'export.delivered' with requestor id. Telemetry: console.audit.export_count and console.audit.export_size_bytes.

maria: what about privacy/redaction? default compact should mask emails/PII unless requester has IAM role 'compliance:exports:full'.

sam: implementation notes: presigned S3 link TTL 1h, but we should sign bundle with a proof token so partners can verify origin without exposing raw PII. Maybe include a detached signature file.

kevin: sample NDJSON row:
```
{"actor_id":"u-998","ts":"2024-11-20T15:02:31Z","action":"routing.policy.update","diff":"eyJ..."}
```

maria: UX microcopy: 'Download evidence bundle (includes signed proof, can be used for audit ingestion)'. Show estimated size and quota cost. Block download if monthly export quota exceeded, with link to request quota bump.

audit-bot: export.requested by maria (u-998) for tenant t-555, size_estimate=12MB, preflight_ok=true

deploy-bot: deploy finished for rollout/123-canary; no export hook triggered

jen: one more edge: canary-only exports — include canary snapshot + rollout window; helpful for proving who changed what during canary.

sam: agree. I'll sketch API shape: POST /api/v1/exports -> {scope:'rollout', id:'123', format:'ndjson|bundle', redact:'compact|full', notify:'email|webhook'} -> returns {export_id, presigned_url, eta}

maria: perfect. I'll add to the rollout PR. tagging @kevin for API review and @jen for telemetry metrics.

kevin: read. will review API + signer design tomorrow. :thumbsup:
